meta.name: agent-development
meta.description:
Design and build custom Claude Code agents with effective descriptions, tool access patterns,
and self-documenting prompts. Covers Task tool delegation, model selection, memory limits,
and declarative instruction design.

Use when: creating custom agents, designing agent descriptions for auto-delegation,
troubleshooting agent memory issues, or building agent pipelines.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 设计和构建自定义Claude Code代理
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要设计、构建或调试Claude Code自定义代理。
copy.tagline_en: Design and build custom Claude Code agents
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to design, build, or debug custom Claude Code agents.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能根据你设计的描述自动或手动调用子代理，执行代码审查、文件处理等任务，并返回结构化报告。
howto.when: 当你创建或修改自定义代理的描述文件，或通过 Task 工具指定子代理名称时触发。

say.text: 用 Task 工具调用 agent-name 子代理处理这个任务。
say.note: Claude 会显式调用指定代理。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can automatically or manually invoke sub-agents based on designed descriptions to perform tasks like code review and file processing, returning structured reports.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you create or modify a custom agent's description file, or when you use the Task tool to specify a sub-agent name.

say_en.text: Create a code review agent with description including 'MUST BE USED when reviewing code'.
say_en.note: Claude will generate an agent description file.

say_en.text: Use Task tool to invoke agent-name sub-agent for this task.
say_en.note: Claude will explicitly call the specified agent.
